# CANDIDATE: CHART_STOP_BUFFER_TWEAK

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the chart stop buffer reduces premature stops on bearish rejection entries, allowing more of the ribbon ride to capture, especially on days like 4/29 and 5/04 where the rejection candle close is near the level but the move continues. A smaller buffer increases the chance that the trade stays open through minor retracements above the rejected level, thereby improving edge capture on BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup.

## Mechanism

The chart stop for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON triggers when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + buffer (currently $0.50). This proposal reduces the buffer to $0.30, making the stop less sensitive to small retracements. Entry, TP1, runner, profit-lock, and time stop remain unchanged. The change is implemented via `params.json#chart_stop_buffer_dollars`.
